OPEN-01.purpose: Keep identity, source attribution and the original record intact.
OPEN-01.when: Repeat for every newly started recording; this is not a proposal for additional identity documents.
OPEN-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

OPEN-02.purpose: Keep identity, source attribution and the original record intact.
OPEN-02.when: Confirm applicable notice/authorization arrangements institutionally; this wording is not a universal compliance determination.
OPEN-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

BASIS-01.purpose: Keep identity, source attribution and the original record intact.
BASIS-01.when: Record the request and offered facts; do not coach the applicant to select a ground.
BASIS-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

BASIS-02.purpose: Keep identity, source attribution and the original record intact.
BASIS-02.when: Preserve the original and separately attribute any correction, confirmation or clarification.
BASIS-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

CLOSE-01.purpose: Keep identity, source attribution and the original record intact.
CLOSE-01.when: Close within relevance; preserve corrections without silently rewriting earlier records.
CLOSE-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

DEC-01.purpose: The decision process and the applicant’s reasons at the time.
DEC-01.when: Use where the formation decision is relevant; skip the probe if reasons were already given.
prompts: What were your reasons for marrying at that time?
DEC-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
DEC-01.recommended: How did the decision to marry arise?

DEC-02.purpose: Personal understanding, actual discussion and expressed agreement as distinct facts.
DEC-02.when: Use in a relevant formation inquiry; ask only the components not already answered.
prompts: What had you actually discussed together about those responsibilities?
What, if anything, did you agree?
DEC-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
DEC-02.recommended: Before marriage, what did you understand your responsibilities in married life would be?

DEC-03.purpose: The statement’s content, speaker, timing and any expressed response.
DEC-03.when: Only pursue an identified important statement; skip response clarification if DEC-02 already covers it.
prompts: What was said, by whom and when?
What, if anything, did the other person say in response?
DEC-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
DEC-03.recommended: Was a specific promise, agreement or condition important to your decision?

DEC-04.purpose: The asserted discrepancy and the sequence of later knowledge.
DEC-04.when: Use only if a difference is identified; reuse CON and EVD where already answered.
prompts: What was the difference?
When and how did you learn it?
What supporting information has not already been identified?
DEC-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
DEC-04.recommended: Did what you understood differ from what you later learned?

CHD-01.purpose: Actual discussions and any reported agreement about having children.
CHD-01.when: Use where this subject is relevant; do not require reproductive details.
CHD-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CHD-01.recommended: Before marriage, what did you discuss or agree about having children?
CHD-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

CHD-02.purpose: Whether a difference was expressed and what was said.
CHD-02.when: Ask the probe if a difference is identified and its communication is unclear.
prompts: What was actually communicated?
CHD-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CHD-02.recommended: Were there differences about whether or when to have children?

CHD-03.purpose: Actual change versus later discovery of an earlier position, with timing and source.
CHD-03.when: Use the branch supported by the account; ask both only if both sequences are alleged.
prompts: If expectations changed: what changed, when, and what was communicated?
If this concerns discovery: what did you learn, when, and how?
CHD-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CHD-03.recommended: Did those expectations change later, or did you later learn something different about an earlier expectation?

CHD-04.purpose: A particular relevant parenting event, not a parenting-quality assessment.
CHD-04.when: Activate only for an identified connection to the petition.
CHD-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CHD-04.recommended: If relevant to this petition, describe a specific parenting responsibility or disagreement and what happened.
CHD-04.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

CHD-05.purpose: The identified support and its relevant scope.
CHD-05.when: Skip repetition where the same support is already recorded in EVD.
CHD-05.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CHD-05.recommended: What facts or documents support this account? Do not include unrelated private information about children.
CHD-05.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

MON-01.purpose: What was actually discussed before marriage.
MON-01.when: Use for a relevant financial issue; do not expand into a full audit.
MON-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MON-01.recommended: Before marriage, what did you discuss about work, income, debts and financial responsibilities?
MON-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

MON-02.purpose: The specific alleged omission or representation, without assuming deliberate deception.
MON-02.when: Select the relevant branch; skip details already recorded in CON.
prompts: What particular fact or agreement are you referring to?
If represented differently: what were you told?
If not disclosed: what had been discussed about that subject, if anything?
MON-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MON-02.recommended: Was there an important financial fact or agreement you say was not disclosed or was represented differently?

MON-03.purpose: The particular event, participants and timing.
MON-03.when: Ask only missing components of an identified relevant event.
prompts: When did it occur?
Who was involved?
What happened?
MON-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MON-03.recommended: Describe a specific financial decision or disagreement relevant to this petition.

MON-04.purpose: Contemporaneous knowledge versus later information and its source.
MON-04.when: Relate the answer to the financial event at issue; reuse TIM or CON.
prompts: What did you discover later?
How did you discover it?
MON-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MON-04.recommended: What did you know at that time?

MON-05.when: Use EVD for already-recorded provenance and version details.
MON-05.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MON-05.recommended: Which evidence supports the particular fact, and what is uncertain or disputed?
MON-05.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

INT-01.purpose: The difficulty and the separate occurrence/awareness sequence.
INT-01.when: Proceed only within the difficulty the applicant identifies; do not infer an affirmative answer.
prompts: When did it arise, if known?
When did it become known to you?
INT-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
INT-01.recommended: Is there a specific intimate marital difficulty you wish to explain?

INT-02.purpose: Earlier understanding and the claimed later difference.
INT-02.when: Use only if directly relevant; reuse DEC or CON where already covered.
prompts: What was different afterward?
INT-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
INT-02.recommended: If relevant, what had been discussed or understood before marriage?

INT-03.purpose: The applicant’s asserted connection between the specific difficulty and petition.
INT-03.when: Do not invite unrelated intimate information.
INT-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
INT-03.recommended: How does this specific difficulty relate to your request? Include only the facts you wish to explain.
INT-03.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

PRS-01.purpose: Whether the applicant identifies a relevant influence and what it was.
PRS-01.when: If none is identified, skip PRS-02–04 unless an existing statement needs clarification.
prompts: If so, describe it.
PRS-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
PRS-01.recommended: Was there any pressure, threat or other circumstance that you say affected your decision to marry?

PRS-02.when: Only for an identified relevant circumstance.
prompts: Who or what was the source?
When did it occur?
PRS-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

PRS-03.purpose: Described decision effect and actual contemporaneous communication.
PRS-03.when: Do not assume that an identified circumstance affected the decision in a particular way.
prompts: What did you communicate at the time?
PRS-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
PRS-03.recommended: How did it affect your decision?

PRS-04.when: Reuse EVD; do not impose corroboration as a universal requirement.
prompts: What evidence or contemporaneous information supports it?
PRS-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

DBT-01.purpose: Any contemporaneous serious reservation identified by the applicant.
DBT-01.when: A negative or unknown answer does not authorize speculative probing.
DBT-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
DBT-01.recommended: What serious reservations, if any, did you have before the wedding?
DBT-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

DBT-02.when: Ask only unanswered components if discussion occurred.
prompts: What did you say?
To whom did you say it?
What response or action followed?
DBT-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

DBT-03.purpose: Reasons and knowledge at the time, not later retrospective judgment.
DBT-03.when: Reuse DEC where the same reasons were already recorded.
prompts: What relevant facts were known then?
DBT-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
DBT-03.recommended: Why did you proceed at that time?

WED-01.purpose: Whether a particular relevant event is identified.
WED-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
WED-01.recommended: Did a specific event immediately before or at the ceremony affect willingness or ability to proceed?
WED-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

WED-02.purpose: Event content, timing and direct recollection.
WED-02.when: Only for the event identified under WED-01.
prompts: When did it happen?
What do you remember directly?
WED-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

WED-03.when: Skip response or evidence components already covered by WED-02 or EVD.
prompts: What other information supports your account, if not already identified?
WED-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
WED-03.recommended: Was anything said or done at the time in response to this event?

CON-01.purpose: The particular alleged discrepancy or omission.
CON-01.when: Use only for an identified allegation, not a search for every undisclosed fact.
CON-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CON-01.recommended: What important fact do you say was represented differently or not disclosed before marriage?
CON-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

CON-02.purpose: The actual representation and its context, or the relevant discussion where no statement is alleged.
CON-02.when: Do not force an answer to what was said where the account concerns only nondisclosure.
prompts: By whom and when?
If the allegation concerns only an omission: what had been discussed about that subject, if anything?
CON-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

CON-03.when: Reuse DEC; avoid replacing historical inquiry with a hypothetical present-day decision.
prompts: Why was that fact important to your decision?
CON-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CON-03.recommended: What did you believe when deciding to marry?

CON-04.when: Only if a difference is identified; preserve unknown occurrence dates.
prompts: How did you learn it?
CON-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CON-04.recommended: When did you learn the difference?

CON-05.purpose: Support for each component rather than a global concealment label.
CON-05.when: Reuse EVD for exact items and limitations.
prompts: What remains uncertain?
CON-05.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
CON-05.recommended: What evidence supports each part of this sequence?

INF-01.purpose: The conduct alleged rather than a label alone.
INF-01.when: Let the initial account proceed before asking the probe; use the detailed dossier only for unresolved material facts.
prompts: What specific actions or communications are you referring to?
INF-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
INF-01.recommended: Please describe, in your own words, the conduct you allege and its relevance to this petition.
INF-01.disposition: Refine for an open factual account.

INF-02.when: Accept unknown occurrence dates; reuse TIM for exact/approximate distinctions.
prompts: When did you first learn of it?
INF-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
INF-02.recommended: When do you say the alleged conduct occurred?

INF-03.when: Ask only unresolved distinctions; a lack of direct observation does not mean no personal knowledge of a statement or document.
prompts: What information came from another source?
Which parts are your interpretation or suspicion, if that remains unclear?
INF-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
INF-03.recommended: What did you experience or observe directly?

INF-04.purpose: Specific support linked to particular assertions.
INF-04.when: Reuse EVD; do not ask for all devices, accounts or communications.
prompts: Which submitted item do you mean, and what particular fact do you say it supports?
INF-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
INF-04.recommended: What specific evidence supports your account?

ABD-01.when: Reuse SEP/TIM for an already-recorded period.
prompts: What circumstances do you know directly?
ABD-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABD-01.recommended: When did the separation or absence begin?

ABD-02.purpose: What continued, not merely what ceased.
ABD-02.when: Permit none, unknown or a qualified account without inferred motives.
ABD-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABD-02.recommended: What relevant communication, contact or support continued, if any?
ABD-02.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

ABD-03.when: Reuse REC where already recorded; no advice or requirement to make further contact.
prompts: What happened?
ABD-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABD-03.recommended: What attempts were made to communicate or reconcile?

ABD-04.purpose: Certainty and basis for material dates/reasons.
ABD-04.when: Relate each answer to an identified event or explanation.
prompts: What supports the particular date or stated reason?
ABD-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABD-04.recommended: Which dates or reasons are known, estimated or unknown?

ABU-01.purpose: The relevant conduct or pattern the applicant identifies.
ABU-01.when: Stay within the petition issue; do not compel a full biography.
ABU-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABU-01.recommended: Describe the relevant incident or pattern you wish the Council to consider.
ABU-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

ABU-02.when: Only ask missing components; no requirement to date every incident exactly.
prompts: When did it happen?
Was this one incident or did something similar happen on other occasions?
If repetition is identified and remains unclear: describe the relevant pattern.
ABU-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABU-02.recommended: What did you experience or observe directly?

ABU-03.purpose: Concrete described effects relevant to the petition.
ABU-03.when: Clarify an identifiable event/change only if the answer is general.
ABU-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABU-03.recommended: What relevant effect did it have on married life or the decision to separate?
ABU-03.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

ABU-04.purpose: Existing relevant material and its actual nature.
ABU-04.when: Do not imply records must exist or require a new report.
ABU-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ABU-04.recommended: Are there existing court orders, reports or other evidence you wish to identify?
ABU-04.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

FTH-01.purpose: Reported earlier affiliation with knowledge limits.
FTH-01.when: Accept unknown information about the other party.
FTH-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
FTH-01.recommended: What was each party’s religious affiliation before you knew each other, to your knowledge?
FTH-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

FTH-02.purpose: The particular stated change and timing.
FTH-02.when: Do not substitute an attendance pattern for an established affiliation change.
prompts: When did it occur?
FTH-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
FTH-02.recommended: What later change in affiliation or practice is relevant to this request?

prompts: What were you told?
FTH-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

FTH-04.when: Keep doctrinal conclusions for authorized institutional assessment.
prompts: What information supports that account?
FTH-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
FTH-04.recommended: How did the stated change affect married life?

ADD-01.when: Do not convert this into a diagnostic screening checklist.
ADD-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ADD-01.recommended: Describe the behavior relevant to this petition rather than only giving it a label.
ADD-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

ADD-02.purpose: Known onset versus first awareness and source.
ADD-02.when: Accept unknown onset; do not use discovery as onset automatically.
prompts: When did you first become aware of it?
How did you become aware of it?
ADD-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ADD-02.recommended: When did the behavior begin, if known?

ADD-03.purpose: Relevant concrete events or changes attributed to the behavior.
ADD-03.when: Clarify only if the claimed effect remains abstract.
ADD-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ADD-03.recommended: How did the behavior affect married life?
ADD-03.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

ADD-04.purpose: Known help and support for the account.
ADD-04.when: Use MED safeguards; no inference from lack of known treatment.
prompts: What evidence or direct observations support your account?
ADD-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
ADD-04.recommended: What help was sought, if known?

BKG-01.when: If no connection is identified, do not expand background questioning.
BKG-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
BKG-01.recommended: Is there a specific earlier experience directly connected to an issue in this petition?
BKG-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

BKG-02.purpose: The event, asserted relevance and knowledge basis.
BKG-02.when: Avoid repeating a source account already recorded under EVD.
prompts: Which parts do you know directly?
Which parts were you told?
BKG-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
BKG-02.recommended: Explain the relevant event and its connection to the issue.

BKG-03.purpose: Basis and limits of the claimed connection.
BKG-03.when: Do not equate temporal sequence with demonstrated causation.
prompts: What is unknown?
BKG-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

TIM-01.purpose: First appearance and its relationship to the marriage date.
TIM-01.when: Ask the second part only if the sequence is unresolved.
prompts: Were they evident before or after marriage?
TIM-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
TIM-01.recommended: When did the relevant difficulties first appear?

TIM-02.when: Attach the account to the relevant event, not a generic undated narrative.
prompts: What became known later?
TIM-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
TIM-02.recommended: What did you know at the time?

TIM-03.purpose: Date certainty for identified material events.
TIM-03.when: Reuse dates already clarified; do not require an exact day where none is known.
TIM-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
TIM-03.recommended: Which important dates are exact, approximate or unknown? Relate each date to a specific event.
TIM-03.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

SEP-01.when: If none, proceed to the final separation where relevant.
SEP-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
SEP-01.recommended: Were there relevant temporary separations before the final one?
SEP-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

SEP-02.purpose: Dates, circumstances, actual resumption and its reported cause.
SEP-02.when: Repeat only for relevant periods; ask reunion detail only if residence resumed.
prompts: Did you resume living together afterward?
If yes: what led to resuming life together?
SEP-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
SEP-02.recommended: For each relevant period, describe the approximate beginning and end dates and the circumstances that led to separation.

SEP-03.purpose: The final separation distinguished from prior periods.
SEP-03.when: Ask only unresolved components; preserve uncertain final dates.
prompts: When did it occur?
What were the circumstances?
What do you know directly?
SEP-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

SEP-04.purpose: Support and limits for the separation account.
SEP-04.when: Reuse TIM/EVD instead of a new application or separation-case module.
SEP-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
SEP-04.recommended: Identify supporting information and uncertain dates without treating separation as a new case.
SEP-04.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

REC-01.when: Do not advise or require another attempt.
REC-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
REC-01.recommended: What relevant attempts at reconciliation were made?
REC-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

REC-02.when: Ask only missing components of the same attempt.
prompts: Who participated?
Approximately when did it occur?
REC-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

REC-03.when: No inference that attendance means reconciliation succeeded.
REC-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
REC-03.recommended: Distinguish the outcome you observed from information you received from someone else.
REC-03.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

REC-04.purpose: Unresolved facts and identified existing records.
REC-04.when: Do not request confessional content or create a general priest interview.
prompts: What existing records are relevant?
REC-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.

EVD-01.when: Identify the item and assertion; avoid a global claim that evidence proves the entire account.
EVD-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
EVD-01.recommended: Which specific fact does each item support?
EVD-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

EVD-02.purpose: Origin/acquisition and the form/version actually supplied.
EVD-02.when: Ask version detail only if unclear; accept unknown and do not demand technical authentication.
prompts: Is the item supplied complete, or is it a copy, extract, transcription, translation or another version?
Describe any changes you know of.
EVD-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
EVD-02.recommended: Who created this item, when, and how did you obtain it, if known?

EVD-03.purpose: Knowledge basis for the particular assertion.
EVD-03.when: Clarify the original source versus intermediaries only where material.
EVD-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
EVD-03.recommended: What did you personally experience, observe or learn from another source?
EVD-03.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

EVD-04.purpose: Limits, contrary information and uncertainty within disclosure boundaries.
EVD-04.when: Do not expose private submissions to create a contradiction question.
EVD-04.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
EVD-04.recommended: What limitations, conflicting information or uncertainty should the Council know? Do not disclose the other applicant’s private submission.
EVD-04.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

MED-01.purpose: Known relevant evaluation/help, including evaluation without treatment.
MED-01.when: Activate only for a specific relevant issue; no general mental-health screening.
MED-01.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MED-01.recommended: To your knowledge, have you or your spouse received a medical, psychological or psychiatric evaluation, treatment or other professional help directly relevant to the issue being discussed? It is acceptable not to know.
MED-01.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.

MED-02.purpose: Relevant help, timing and asserted connection.
MED-02.when: Do not seek unrelated clinical detail; disclosure/testing remains separately authorized.
prompts: Approximately when did it occur?
How do you say it relates to the issue in this petition?
MED-02.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MED-02.recommended: If so, describe only the relevant evaluation, treatment or help.
MED-02.disposition: Replace pending wording and break down.

MED-03.when: Do not repeat EVD if answered; no response authorizes records access.
MED-03.source: Perplexity review: optional editorial guidance; no external claims adopted.
MED-03.recommended: Which parts of this account do you know directly, which were reported to you, and what remains unknown?
MED-03.disposition: Replace pending wording; preserve safeguard separately.
MED-03.clarificationNote: No additional routine probe proposed. Use existing TIM/EVD only for a material unresolved distinction.
